def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=grid[0][0]
    vals={x for row in grid for x in row if x!=bg}
    fg=next(iter(vals))
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==fg]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Complete the outer rectangular frame in the added color.
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in (c0,c1):
            if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
    for r in (r0,r1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
    # Complete interior horizontal bars indicated by foreground cells in the row.
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        if any(grid[r][c]==fg for c in range(c0+1,c1)):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
    return out
